title: Chip Stocks: Who Actually Got Rich in 10 Years #stocks #investing
description:
Free market intel: https://www.signumhq.com/app?src=yt_stat1

$10,000 into three chip stocks in August 2016.

NVIDIA +13,934%. AMD +6,295%. Intel +151%.

Same industry, same decade, same starting money.

Split-adjusted closing prices.

#stocks #investing #nvidia #amd #intel #semiconductors
pinnedComment:
All three were chip stocks anyone could name in 2016. Which one did you actually hold?

Free app: https://www.signumhq.com/app?src=yt_stat1c
evidence: Percentages are (close_2026/close_2016 - 1) x 100 on the same $10,000

story.event: The AI accelerator cycle split the chip sector: Nvidia and AMD rode it, Intel spent the decade losing its manufacturing lead.
story.mechanism: All three sold chips to overlapping customers in 2016 and a retail investor could name every one of them, so the gap is execution rather than access or information.
story.anchor: NVDA +13,934% vs INTC +151% on the same $10,000

insight.claim: Same sector, same decade, same money: NVIDIA returned 92x what Intel did.
